extracted.intended_audience: patrons booking reservations or attending shows at the Comedy Cellar (New York)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules, requirements, and procedures for making, modifying, and using reservations at the Comedy Cellar (New York), including age limits, party-size rules, minimums, seating/standby policies, and pricing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation process
rubrics_metrics.description: Please click 'Cancel' next to the reservation you would like to cancel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you placed a reservation and cannot find it in this list, please call us at 212-254-3480. Verify reservation info and click Make Reservation to confirm when booking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance / contact options
rubrics_metrics.description: If you encounter any issue please call us at 212-254-3480 or reach us through our contact form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the phone number for urgent issues or when reservations do not appear; a contact form is available for other inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age requirement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email us for exceptions if 18 with a parent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Party size limits (location-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Parties larger than 8 are NOT allowed in the MacDougal Street location and no larger than 4 in the Fat Black Pussy Cat location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Our space is limited, intimate and cozy. Even if split into multiple reservations we find that parties larger than this are usually noisy (even without meaning to be) and this disrupts the show. Multiple reservations resulting in groups larger than this will also not be honored. Over the years we have found this to be an essential rule to follow. Sorry for any inconvenience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-item minimum per person
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Food or drink or bottle of water satisfy the minimum. (Stated repeatedly: '2 item minimum per person. Food or Drink or bottle of water.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Sold-out / standby seating policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We cannot take any more reservations for this show when sold out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In order to avoid overbooking, remaining seats will be given out at the Comedy Cellar at show time. If you would like to attend this show, we encourage you to come down shortly before show time for seats. Seating is first-come first-serve AFTER our confirmed reservations are seated, so you must check in with the host as soon as you arrive to secure your position in line. You have a good chance of getting a seat, but we CANNOT guarantee that there will be room for you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reservation information required
rubrics_metrics.description: Bookers must provide and verify required contact and reservation details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required fields shown: Date, Time, First Name, Last Name, Size, Phone, Email, How Heard, Send SMS. Please verify your reservation info then click Make Reservation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Website/verification protection notice
rubrics_metrics.description: This site is protected by reCAPTCHA and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should be aware of reCAPTCHA verification during the reservation process and the associated privacy/terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performer appearance disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: Individual comedian appearance subject to change without notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Great stars may drop in without notice; appearances can change, but the venue notes that all shows are great and they are confident you'll enjoy yourself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phone-free policy / device pouch requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All of our shows are phone free!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We ask all guests to place their phones and smart watches into the pouches we provide (you will of course maintain possession of them) for the duration of the show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Late-night (AM) show labeling rule
rubrics_metrics.description: AM shows (after midnight) are the LATE NIGHT shows of the day chosen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: the Saturday 12:15 AM show is technically Sunday morning but it is still the Saturday late show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing schedule and show-specific exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Day-based pricing applies with exceptions for special shows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prices: Friday & Saturday All Shows $25.00; Monday All Shows $15.00 (Except: New Joke Night Show: $10); Tuesday & Wednesday All Shows $15.00 (Except: Hot Soup Comedy Show: $20 and The Chemistry Set: $20); Thursday & Sunday All Shows $18.00; Holidays & Special Events: $25.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reservation splitting and noise policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple reservations resulting in groups larger than allowed will not be honored.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if split into multiple reservations we find that parties larger than the stated limits are usually noisy (even without meaning to be) and this disrupts the show; for that reason split reservations creating oversized groups are refused.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check-in / line-positioning requirement for standby
rubrics_metrics.description: To secure a position in line for standby seating you must check in with the host as soon as you arrive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seating for walk-ins is first-come first-serve after confirmed reservations have been seated; checking in promptly secures your place in the standby line but does not guarantee seating.
